TITLE: The Cathedral of Vending Machines
TEXT:
At 2:00 a.m. the vending machines glow
like small altars.

You press buttons as if praying.
B7. C2. D4.

They offer:
sugar
salt
a cold bottle that says YOU CAN CONTINUE.

I have watched people stand before them
with the seriousness of confession.
No audience.
No sermon.
Only the hum.

If there is a god of the night shift,
it lives behind glass
and takes coins without judgment.
